name: Outdated Template Updater for WooCommerce
author: Dazze Studio

sections.description:
This plugin detects outdated WooCommerce template file(s) located in your active theme and updates their version numbers to match the latest template versions used by WooCommerce.

Useful for theme developers and store owners who want to keep things clean and reduce error warnings without manually updating every file.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce → Outdated Template Updater to run the update process.
